sentences.en: Public aviaries are often found in parks and zoological gardens.
sentences.zh: 公共鸟笼通常可以在公园和动物学的动物园中找到。

sentences.en: In the zoological gardens of Mars, there are animals from Earth.
sentences.zh: 在火星的动物学动物园里，有来自地球的动物。

sentences.en: The whale belongs to the zoological order of mammals.
sentences.zh: 鲸鱼属于哺乳纲中的动物学分类。
